evals.prompt: Please sync the latest course info from the Google Sheet into `data/courses.json`. Keep `source` as the canonical JSON and preserve the upstream sheet in `importSource`.
evals.expected_output: An updated canonical courses JSON or a blocked report if the schema or consumer mapping is inconsistent.

assertions.text: Names `data/courses.json` as the canonical target and keeps the Google Sheet as import-only source.
Mentions both `source` and `importSource` semantics instead of collapsing them into one field.
Checks downstream consumers such as `courses-data.js` or `courseplan.html` before claiming success.
Returns a blocked report instead of inventing course content when the source or schema is unavailable.
Treats the canonical JSON as the write target even when the upstream sheet is the import source.

evals.prompt: Update the advisee data from the Word export and make sure the public pages still read the canonical JSON rather than the import file.
evals.expected_output: An updated `data/advisees.json` or a blocked report explaining the mismatch, plus confirmation that the page loaders still align with the canonical file.

assertions.text: Identifies `data/advisees.json` as canonical and the Word export as import-only.
Names the relevant consumers such as `advisees-data.js`, `advisee.html`, or `advisee_faculty.html`.
Either reports an updated canonical JSON or explains the schema mismatch that blocked the update.

evals.prompt: The regular activity data changed in the CSV. Canonicalize it into `data/regular_event.json`, keep the import source separate, and verify the public page still parses the data.
evals.expected_output: A canonical regular event JSON update with source/importSource preserved and a verification note that `regular_event.html` still loads the JSON cleanly.

assertions.text: Names `data/regular_event.json` as the canonical output and the CSV as import-only.
Verifies `regular_event.html` or an equivalent consumer still parses the JSON cleanly.
